mods.0: For a long time, people have used tools that turn natural events we cannot sense into things we can perceive.

options: People have long used tools to make what we cannot sense into something we can perceive.
Our senses are strong enough to notice most natural events without any tools.
Telescopes were the first tool that changed what humans can hear.
People should stop relying on tools to understand the natural world.
Light and sound are the only things that humans cannot perceive.
explain: 인간은 오랫동안 감각으로 지각할 수 없는 자연 현상을 지각 가능한 것으로 바꿔 주는 도구를 이용해 왔다는 것이 글의 요지이다.

mods.0: For many years, people have used tools that bring natural phenomena we can’t sense into our perception.
mods.1: In some cases, this consists of simply {1|amplifying} signals that feed into our normal sensory inputs (e.g., telescopes can bring into clear view that which is too far away for our eyes to perceive on their own).
mods.2: Other instruments turn signals that we cannot perceive into ones that we can {2|ignore}.
mods.3: Some of these take the form of expanding the {3|reach} of our current senses, such as creating visible images based on the ultraviolet spectrum of light or changing sounds that are normally {4|outside} the range of what human ears can hear into audible signals.
mods.4: Alternatively, some instruments {5|measure} properties for which we have no sensory capacity at all and change them into that which we can observe.

explain: ② 도구는 우리가 지각할 수 없는 신호를 우리가 관찰(observe)할 수 있는 신호로 바꿔 주므로 ignore는 문맥상 부적절하다.
